name: SIGMA - Domain Controller Discovery via Nltest [threshold]
description: Elastic threshold companion for rules/sigma/proc_creation_win_nltest_discovery.yml (issue #217). The Sigma rule was demoted to level:low (single-event, no timeframe, floods on routine domain administration/diagnostics) rather than removed - a single deliberate execution by an attacker still needs to be recorded, it just should not carry medium severity alone. This threshold rule restores the higher-severity signal for what actually distinguishes automated recon tooling from routine diagnostics: nltest enumeration executed repeatedly on the SAME host within a short window.
author: Suburban-SOC
false_positives: A domain administration or diagnostics script that legitimately calls nltest more than once against the same host in a short window.
